body:
## Change

F1. Release-version parser already rejects leading zeroes in major/minor/patch; now rejects them in numeric prerelease identifiers too. Preserve alphanumeric identifiers and leading-zero build metadata.

## Validation

V1. Behavioral RED/GREEN exercises parseChannel with invalid 1.0.0-01 and 1.0.0-alpha.01, valid -0, -alpha.01x and +01 controls. Parent reviewed regex alternatives and release input path; reran 59 parser/contract tests. Worker boundaries: 52; typecheck, targeted lint/format/diff passed.

## Assumptions / limits

L1. Existing releaseVersion grammar and package-version identity imply Semantic Versioning semantics. No live publishing or remote namespace mutation tested. Full repo gates not run locally; CI separate.
title: fix(asset-delivery): reject malformed numeric prerelease versions
